ops.title: Distinguish post-release CI observation errors from child CI failure
ops.description: Owner execution /root/synckit_cci_ship_finish under root coordination. CCX48 descriptor job124190660629 raw log ends17:13:47 with gh run watch HTTP502 for exact child41093622633; consumer release.yml backgrounds watchers and maps any wait error to status1. Root reports child immutable CI later SUCCESS; CCI.7 and CCX.50 analogous reports await direct binding. Root selected bounded existing consumer CCX+CCI observers, no new shared action. On watcher nonzero, reconcile ONCE same immutable RunID authoritative status/conclusion; pass completed SUCCESS only unless actual existing source proves another intentional accepted outcome. Terminal CI failure retained; pending/unavailable explicit UNKNOWN observerfailure, never falsely childfailed. Preserve dispatch count1/sourcebinding; no observer retry, redispatch, rebuild, retag, descriptor mutation or timeout policy. Next: isolated latest-main candidates, deterministic CI regression fixtures, independent review, fullCI and normal consumer merges so future releases consume source. FE/shared-publisher-observer-delivery.json canonical.

ops.text: CI fixtures distinguish watcher transport error with confirmed same-run success, terminal CI failure, nonterminal and unavailable observations; no false success or falsely attributed CI failure.
Observer reconciliation is exactly one read of the existing immutable RunID and preserves one dispatch plus original source binding; no retry/redispatch/tag/build/descriptor mutations.
Root-reviewed bounded CCX and CCI consumer changes pass required CI and merge normally; future official release workflows consume merged observers, historical releases remain unchanged.
